question: ¿Cuántos anticuerpos monoclonales distintos se prueban en ensayos de cáncer de pulmón?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT td.parent_chembl_id)
FROM linking.trial_drug td
JOIN linking.drug_class dc ON dc.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id AND dc.class = 'MonoclonalAntibody'
JOIN linking.trial_condition tc ON tc.nct_id = td.nct_id
JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
JOIN mesh.descriptor d ON d.id = a.ancestor_id AND d.label = 'Lung Neoplasms'
